nodes.label: Bound SQL values
nodes.rationale: Identifiers are catalog-validated and quoted; user values use placeholders to prevent injection.

nodes.label: Legacy insert profiles
nodes.rationale: SQL-valid null/default values can make a row invisible to the legacy application.

nodes.label: Atomic machine link replacement
nodes.rationale: Agreement changes, link clearing and reassignment share one cursor and roll back together.

nodes.label: Atomic write transactions
nodes.rationale: write_session commits on success and rolls back on any exception.

nodes.label: Protected agreement reservation
nodes.rationale: PROTECTED WRITE on UMOWACPC serializes writers across processes, so free-ID allocation cannot race.

nodes.label: Business identifier ambiguity
nodes.rationale: Nonunique business identifiers must resolve exactly one row or return 409 before mutation.

nodes.label: Immutable settlement parents
nodes.rationale: Legacy updates recompute only NEW parent totals, so moving a settlement would leave old totals stale.

nodes.label: Lowercase Polish wire fields
nodes.rationale: The JSON keys preserve original database column names to avoid a translation layer.

nodes.label: Referenced agreement deletion guard
nodes.rationale: Preserving related rows prevents stale references attaching to a reused agreement identifier.

nodes.label: Trigger-maintained aggregates
nodes.rationale: The API stores supplied amounts; database triggers recalculate parent costs, revenue and profit.

nodes.label: Firebird statement message budget
nodes.rationale: The 64 KB statement-message limit permits at most 63 VARCHAR(1024) search parameters.

nodes.label: Read-only reads
nodes.rationale: A guarded single SELECT/WITH and unconditional read rollback prevent committing mutations.

nodes.label: Apple Silicon transaction binding
nodes.rationale: A fixed-signature isc_start_multiple binding avoids the variadic calling-convention mismatch.

nodes.label: Bounded connection pool
nodes.rationale: Pool capacity and acquisition timeout bound concurrency; broken connections are discarded.

nodes.label: Curated paginated projections
nodes.rationale: COUNT and page query share a connection; hand-picked fields avoid wide statement messages.

nodes.label: Escaped LIKE search
nodes.rationale: Escaping wildcard characters and casting bound patterns avoids short-column Firebird arithmetic exceptions.

nodes.label: Injected service ownership
nodes.rationale: The lifespan closes only a service created by the application.

nodes.label: Read transaction rollback
nodes.rationale: A borrowed connection is rolled back before being returned, avoiding lingering transactions and record locks.

nodes.label: Shared pool and schema cache
nodes.rationale: All resource classes share one BaseDatabaseService state through the DatabaseService facade.

nodes.label: Synchronous route threadpool
nodes.rationale: Sync endpoints keep blocking fdb work off the event loop.

nodes.label: macOS client dependency loading
nodes.rationale: KS_FB_CLIENT selects the native library while loader dependency directories require their own search-path configuration.

nodes.label: Explicit request submission
nodes.rationale: Choosing a route only renders inputs; submitting the form sends a same-origin request.

nodes.label: Customer data exclusion
nodes.rationale: Database rows and credentials must never enter version control, fixtures, docs or logs.

nodes.label: Disposable write test cleanup
nodes.rationale: Write tests must run against a disposable copy and remove the rows they insert.

nodes.label: Lazy database startup
nodes.rationale: The pool and schema cache initialize on first use, so a down database returns 503 without failing boot.
